env BOLERO_MODULE=off
[short] skip

# Set up fresh BOLERO_CACHE.
env BOLERO_CACHE=$WORK/gocache
mkdir $BOLERO_CACHE

# Building a main package should run the compiler and linker ...
bolero build -o $devnull -x main.go
stderr '(compile|gccgo)( |\.exe).*main\.go'
stderr '(link|gccgo)( |\.exe)'

# ... and then the linker again ...
bolero build -o $devnull -x main.go
! stderr '(compile|gccgo)( |\.exe).*main\.go'
stderr '(link|gccgo)( |\.exe)'

# ... but the output binary can serve as a cache.
bolero build -o main$GOEXE -x main.go
stderr '(link|gccgo)( |\.exe)'
bolero build -o main$GOEXE -x main.go
! stderr '(link|gccgo)( |\.exe)'

-- main.go --
package main
func main() {}
